description: Implement a cancellation endpoint for ongoing prewarm operations in the LFC (Local Function Compute) system. This feature should allow users to cancel prewarm requests that are in progress and properly handle the cancellation state transitions in the system. The API specification should be updated to reflect this new endpoint.
functional_requirements: Add a DELETE endpoint at /lfc/prewarm that cancels ongoing prewarm operations
Introduce a 'Cancelled' state for prewarm operations in the state management system
Update the OpenAPI specification to document the new cancellation endpoint and its behavior
Handle the case where LFC is not initialized by adding an 'offload Cancelled' state
Ensure proper state transitions when cancellation occurs to maintain system consistency
Add appropriate error handling for cancellation attempts on non-existent or already-completed prewarm operations
